name: dev-hooks
description: Mick's Claude Code plugins: dev-workflow hooks, coding onboarding, thinking tools, and writing skills.

plugins.name: dev-hooks
plugins.description: Polyglot dev-workflow hooks (lint on edit, verification before stopping, a dangerous-command and secret guard, advisory reminders) plus the skills those hooks point at.

plugins.name: coding-onboarding
plugins.description: Onboarding for people new to coding or to AI-assisted coding: setting up the machine, choosing what to build a first project with, and putting it online.

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Skills for thinking a task through and checking the result: adversarial critique, planning checks, decision records, and verification before claiming done.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing skills: READMEs, plain readable prose, stripping AI tells, and drafting in your own voice.
